overall_goal: Sweeten the hibiscus drink and transfer it to a saucepan to cool

goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bag and a jar of sugar, opens them, and refills the jar to ensure there is sugar available for the recipe.
The person washes and rinses the saucepan at the sink to prepare a clean vessel for the drink.

goals.description: Add sugar and transfer the hibiscus drink to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person adds sugar to the saucepan and then pours the hibiscus drink from the pyrex bowl into the saucepan to mix and cool.
